Star Wars was released theatrically in the United States on May 25 , 1977 .	Star Wars	Star Wars
It earned $ 461 million in the U.S. and $ 314 million overseas , totaling $ 775 million .

It surpassed Jaws -LRB- 1975 -RRB- to become the highest-grossing film of all time until the release of E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial -LRB- 1982 -RRB- .	Jaws	Jaws (film)	highest-grossing film of all time	list of highest-grossing films	E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial	E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
